purpose: Assess ASVS V9 Self-contained Tokens across both token verifiers in the tree, which do not behave the same way.
requiredInvariants: Every V9 decision covers both verifiers; a decision describing only one of them is invalid.
A behavioural accident is never recorded as a control.
PASS only where the control is named by file and re-verified on every run.
FAIL is recorded and reported, never resolved by editing product logic.
Requirement prose from the standard must not be copied into the evidence artifact.
No product logic, dependency, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: V9.2.2 and V9.2.3 name the cabinet session route specifically and credit the staff route, which does check purpose-bearing claims.
V9.1.2 explains why a library default is not the stated allowlist the requirement asks for.
No PASS rests on an access token happening to lack the claim the other verifier reads.
An over-broad absence pattern is proven to fail safe rather than manufacture evidence.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the three authorized paths.
